chains.name: Basis
chains.description: Master data and settings every other chain relies on: contacts, products, units and access.

chains.name: Lead to Cash
chains.description: From the first customer request to the payment received.

chains.name: Source to Pay
chains.description: From a purchase need to the paid vendor bill.

chains.name: Plan to Produce
chains.description: From a confirmed order to a finished, checked product.

chains.name: Record to Report
chains.description: Bookkeeping, period close and management reporting.

chains.name: Hire to Retire
chains.description: People and their time: hours, approvals and internal costs.

roles.name: Customer
roles.description: The customer: sends requests, accepts quotations, receives goods and pays.

roles.name: Management
roles.description: Approves quotations above the limit, vendor bills and timesheets; reviews the figures.

roles.name: Sales
roles.description: Handles requests, quotations and sales orders.

roles.name: Engineering and planning
roles.description: Estimates, prepares bills of materials and plans production.

roles.name: Purchasing and warehouse
roles.description: Buys materials, receives, picks and ships goods.

roles.name: Production
roles.description: Runs manufacturing orders on the shop floor and logs hours.

roles.name: Administration
roles.description: Keeps master data, invoices customers, books vendor bills and closes the period.

roles.name: Supplier
roles.description: The supplier: quotes, delivers and invoices.

activities.name: Create a new customer
activities.click_path:
1. Contacts, New
  2. Set company, address, VAT and payment terms
  3. Save

activities.name: Create a manufactured product
activities.open_point: Which product categories and routes do we need?
activities.click_path:
1. Inventory, Products, New
  2. Tick Manufacture as route
  3. Set unit, category and cost method
  4. Save

activities.name: Create a supplier
activities.click_path:
1. Purchase, Vendors, New
  2. Set address, VAT and payment terms
  3. Save

activities.name: Send a request for quotation
activities.click_path: 1. Email the sales address with drawing and quantity

activities.name: Register the request as a lead
activities.click_path:
1. CRM, check the lead created from the email
  2. Link the customer
  3. Set expected revenue

activities.name: Qualify the lead
activities.open_point: Agree the qualification criteria (fit, capacity, margin).
activities.click_path:
1. CRM, open the lead
  2. Move it to Qualified or mark it lost with a reason

activities.name: Estimate cost and lead time
activities.open_point: Estimate from a bill of materials or from a cost sheet?
activities.click_path:
1. Sales, open the draft quotation
  2. Log the estimate in the chatter
  3. Set the delivery date

activities.name: Draft the quotation
activities.click_path:
1. Sales, New
  2. Add customer, products and quantities
  3. Check prices and delivery date
  4. Save

activities.name: Approve the quotation internally
activities.click_path:
1. Sales, filter To approve
  2. Open the quotation and check the margin
  3. Approve or send back with a note

activities.name: Send the quotation
activities.click_path:
1. Open the quotation
  2. Send by Email
  3. Check the PDF and send

activities.name: Accept the quotation
activities.click_path:
1. Open the link in the email
  2. Sign and accept online

activities.name: Confirm the sales order
activities.click_path:
1. Open the signed quotation
  2. Confirm
  3. Check the manufacturing and delivery orders created

activities.name: Prepare the bill of materials
activities.open_point: One bill of materials per variant or per product?
activities.click_path:
1. Manufacturing, Bills of Materials, New
  2. Add components and operations
  3. Save

activities.name: Plan the manufacturing order
activities.open_point: Plan on work centres or on dates only?
activities.click_path:
1. Manufacturing, open the order
  2. Check component availability
  3. Plan
  4. Set the start date

activities.name: Start the manufacturing order
activities.click_path:
1. Manufacturing, open the order
  2. Start the first work order

activities.name: Report output and consumption
activities.open_point: Report per operation or only at the end?
activities.click_path:
1. Open the manufacturing order
  2. Set the quantity produced
  3. Check consumed components
  4. Mark as done

activities.name: Check the finished product
activities.open_point: Checklist changed after the first trial; confirm with the team.
activities.click_path:
1. Open the manufacturing order
  2. Record the check in the chatter
  3. Mark as done or report the deviation

activities.name: Request a price from the supplier
activities.click_path:
1. Purchase, New
  2. Add supplier and products
  3. Send by Email

activities.name: Send a price and delivery date
activities.click_path: 1. Reply to the request with price and date

activities.name: Confirm the purchase order
activities.click_path:
1. Open the request for quotation
  2. Update price and date
  3. Confirm order

activities.name: Deliver the goods
activities.click_path: 1. Ship the goods with a delivery note

activities.name: Receive the goods
activities.click_path:
1. Inventory, Receipts, open the receipt
  2. Check quantities
  3. Validate

activities.name: Pick and pack the order
activities.open_point: One step or pick, pack and ship?
activities.click_path:
1. Inventory, Deliveries, open the order
  2. Pick the products
  3. Put in pack

activities.name: Ship the order
activities.click_path:
1. Open the delivery
  2. Validate
  3. Print the delivery slip

activities.name: Receive the delivery
activities.click_path: 1. Sign the delivery slip

activities.name: Create the customer invoice
activities.click_path:
1. Sales, To invoice
  2. Create invoice
  3. Check and confirm
  4. Send

activities.name: Pay the invoice
activities.click_path: 1. Pay by bank transfer with the invoice reference

activities.name: Reconcile the payment
activities.click_path:
1. Accounting, Bank, Reconcile
  2. Match the payment to the invoice

activities.name: Send the invoice
activities.click_path: 1. Email the invoice to the bills address

activities.name: Register the vendor bill
activities.click_path:
1. Accounting, Vendor bills, check the bill from the email
  2. Link the purchase order
  3. Check amounts

activities.name: Approve the vendor bill
activities.click_path:
1. Accounting, Vendor bills, filter To approve
  2. Check against the receipt
  3. Confirm the bill

activities.name: Log hours on the project
activities.open_point: Hours on the project or on the work order?
activities.click_path:
1. Timesheets, New
  2. Choose project and task
  3. Enter the hours

activities.name: Approve timesheets
activities.click_path:
1. Timesheets, To validate
  2. Check the hours
  3. Validate

activities.name: Close the month
activities.open_point: Agree the close checklist and the lock date.
activities.click_path:
1. Accounting, check open items
  2. Post accruals
  3. Set the lock date

activities.name: Review the monthly figures
activities.click_path:
1. Accounting, Reporting, Profit and Loss
  2. Compare with last month

scenarios.name: New customer
scenarios.description: A new customer is in Odoo with the right terms, so a quotation can be made.

scenarios.name: From request to quotation
scenarios.description: An emailed request becomes a qualified lead and a costed draft quotation.

scenarios.name: Quote and approve
scenarios.description: The internal approval is not the customer's acceptance: both are needed before the order.

scenarios.name: Production order
scenarios.description: A confirmed order is made: bill of materials, plan, produce, check.

scenarios.name: Purchase and receive
scenarios.description: Materials are bought at the agreed price and received into stock.

scenarios.name: Approve a vendor bill
scenarios.description: A vendor bill is matched to the order and receipt, approved and ready to pay.

scenarios.name: Timesheets on a project
scenarios.description: Hours are logged on the right project and approved.

scenarios.name: Deliver the order
scenarios.description: The finished goods leave with a delivery slip the customer signs.

scenarios.name: Invoice the order
scenarios.description: The delivered order is invoiced, paid and reconciled.

scenarios.name: Close the month
scenarios.description: All open items are booked and the figures are reviewed.

scenarios.name: Make to order, end to end
scenarios.description: One order from the customer's request to the payment received.
